title: Add persistent random blog view counts (700–1000) and increment on blog open

requirements.text: Persist a per-blog view count in the backend so that every blog post (existing and future) has an initial randomly assigned view count between 700 and 1000 (inclusive), and the value can be read by any caller (publicly visible).

quotes: Zorg dat alle blogs achter het oogje een random view count hebben tussen de 700-1000 views, dit geld voor alle huidige blogs en alle komende blogs.
Elke blog moet een random view count tussen de 700-1000 krijgen
Extra - De view count mag gewoon voor iedereen zichtbaar zijn.

acceptanceCriteria: Calling the backend method that returns a blog's view count returns a stable, persisted value for that blog ID.
For a blog ID that has not been assigned a count before, the first assignment is an integer in the inclusive range [700, 1000].
The view count data is readable without requiring authentication/admin permissions.

requirements.text: Implement backend APIs to (1) get a single blog's view count, (2) increment a blog's view count by exactly 1 when the blog is opened, and (3) fetch all view counts keyed by blog ID for list rendering.

quotes: daarna mag elke keer dat die blog geopend word er 1 bij op geteld worden.

acceptanceCriteria: `getBlogViewCount(blogId)` returns the current persisted count for that blog ID (0 is never returned for a published blog once initialized).
`incrementBlogViewCount(blogId)` increases the persisted count by exactly 1 and returns successfully.
`getAllBlogViewCounts()` returns a complete list of (blogId, count) pairs for blogs that exist in storage.

requirements.text: Ensure existing blog posts receive an initial random view count between 700 and 1000 (inclusive) and continue incrementing by +1 per open thereafter.

quotes: Voor bestaande blogs, geef deze een random viewcount tussen 700-1000 en vervolg daarna dat als een blog word geopend er 1 view bij komt.

acceptanceCriteria: After deploying the change, all existing blog posts have an initialized view count in [700, 1000] without requiring manual admin actions.
Incrementing an existing blog post’s view count works and persists across refreshes.
The initialization does not overwrite an already-initialized view count for a blog if it already exists.

requirements.text: Keep view-count storage consistent with blog lifecycle: when a blog post is deleted, its stored view count entry must also be removed so it no longer appears in the "all view counts" result.

quotes: dit geld voor alle huidige blogs en alle komende blogs.

acceptanceCriteria: Deleting a blog post removes its view count entry from backend storage.
After deletion, `getAllBlogViewCounts()` does not include the deleted blog ID.

requirements.text: Update backend stable state and upgrade behavior to safely introduce persisted blog view counts in the existing single-actor canister, including an upgrade/migration path that preserves existing data (blog posts, users, etc.).

quotes: dit geld voor alle huidige blogs en alle komende blogs.
de view count mag opgeslagen worden als dat helpt met de telling vanaf het random nummer bij te houden

acceptanceCriteria: Upgrading the canister does not lose existing stored data (e.g., blog posts, user profiles, other existing state).
After upgrade, the canister initializes missing view counts for existing blog posts (in [700, 1000]) without re-randomizing counts that already exist.

constraints: Respect the single-actor backend architecture (all Motoko logic remains in backend/main.mo).
Only use Internet Identity for authentication; view counts must be publicly readable without auth gating.
Do not edit any frontend files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not implement real analytics, unique visitor tracking, bot detection, or per-user/per-session deduplication of views.
Do not add external databases or third-party analytics services.
Do not redesign the blog UI beyond what is necessary to support the requested view-count behavior.
